deduplication_analysis.reason: The final broad predicates already exist as normalized match semantics; deduplication merges identical matches rather than removing restrictive fields.

flag_lowering_analysis.reason: The broad one-field predicates do not depend on tcp_flags; flag lowering only expands flag-constrained groups and therefore does not explain the observed universal TCP / HOME_NET coverage.

conclusion.interpretation: Semantic safety and operational selectivity are distinct. A NECESSARY predicate can be sound while still being too broad to reduce candidate traffic.
